tasks.label: Scope, reader and method update
tasks.basis: Reusing a framework does not make old findings current. No client approval or completed future edition assumed.

tasks.label: Desktop evidence collection and screening
tasks.basis: Includes useful evidence work, not repeating every internal check/file from the present project; paid datasets excluded unless separately selected.

tasks.label: Guide and record preparation
tasks.basis: Does not change the core or authorise data collection. New material method changes may need more effort.

tasks.label: Research recruitment setup and coordination
tasks.basis: Not a recruitment guarantee. Variable individual handling is WR05; unsuccessful chasing beyond this assumed effort requires reforecast.

tasks.label: Individual scheduling, permission administration and clearance routing
tasks.basis: Model completed usable contributors as a workload driver only; this is not a conversion-rate assumption. Extra unsuccessful attempts remain additional work if incurred.

tasks.label: Contribution collection and structured note
tasks.basis: Not a promised interview duration. No recording/transcription or identifiable-data AI service assumed.

tasks.label: Contribution coding and comparison preparation
tasks.basis: Do not add a second full coding charge merely because the same permitted account informs Table analysis; extra Table-specific work stays separate.

tasks.label: Cross-case synthesis and Decision Framework
tasks.basis: Small purposive input is not representative benchmarking. This is synthesis effort, with prose drafting in WR09.

tasks.label: Full narrative, executive summary and commercial preview
tasks.basis: No arbitrary report word/page ceiling; changed agreed length or evidence complexity requires reforecast. Research collection/synthesis are separate rows.

tasks.label: Substantive fact, source, quotation and rights check
tasks.basis: Not legal advice or a new ownership veto. WR05 administration and this publication review are distinct tasks; do not repeat the same clearance effort.

tasks.label: Copyediting and proofreading
tasks.basis: Editorial hours are a separate work package, not a second full research rewrite.

tasks.label: JGA design and editable report assets
tasks.basis: Uses reusable design system and evidence-supported graphics. Excludes a website, Table financial workbook and invented quantitative charts.

tasks.label: One consolidated editorial revision allowance
tasks.basis: Included contractual remedy work is not a new billable service. Allowance is planning effort, not a cap on corrections or an automatic surcharge.

tasks.label: Final format/data QA and portable handover
tasks.basis: Report supporting Excel data only; no duplicate charge for separate Table financial-model production.

tasks.label: Provider project coordination
tasks.basis: Own labour only. JGA-side decision/review time is retained resource cost, not the same person charged twice.

tasks.label: First-edition research pricing and use-option preparation
tasks.basis: Count a common analysis once if it also informs Table feasibility. This row is not the full six-comparable Table assessment, sponsor sales or contract advice.

tasks.label: Reader scope, context and priorities
tasks.basis: Proposed retained time, no named person or date assigned.

tasks.label: Introductions, eligibility context and follow-through
tasks.basis: Planning block, not an assumed conversion funnel or guaranteed number of recruitable contacts. More chasing can increase actual effort.

tasks.label: Subject-matter and factual review
tasks.basis: Retained expertise does not replace independent fact checking. Review time can overlap with other JGA tasks only if actual work is the same.

tasks.label: Consolidated feedback and decisions
tasks.basis: Client time alongside provider WR13, not an extra provider invoice.

tasks.label: Publication approval and handover decisions
tasks.basis: No approval, acceptance or publication permission presumed by the hours.

tasks.label: Reusable commercial pack and campaign readiness
tasks.basis: Do not recreate or reprice the complete report, its commercial preview, or initial report use-option analysis already in WR09/WR16. A second campaign reuses the asset and costs only real updating work.

tasks.label: Campaign administration, pipeline review and close
tasks.basis: No automatic monthly sales team, retainer, CRM purchase or annual campaign count. Distinguish common review from the same customer contact/proposal work.

tasks.label: Individually handled prospect contact attempt
tasks.basis: Excludes substantive meeting work in WS04 and preparation/negotiation already in WS05/WS06. Not a lead quota, permission to contact or inferred conversion funnel.

tasks.label: Substantive sales discussion and immediate record
tasks.basis: T03 exploratory research is excluded. A no-show records only genuinely incurred preparation/handling, not an invented completed meeting; any real extra effort is retained in the same task record.

tasks.label: Initial scoped proposal preparation
tasks.basis: One partner proposal is one attempt, not a separate licence proposal plus briefing proposal for the same combined offer. This is proposal preparation, not new research or current Table feasibility.

tasks.label: Additional material proposal or negotiation round
tasks.basis: If a complete fresh proposal is counted in WS05, do not also count that same writing in WS06. Record preparation, call and revision within one round once.

tasks.label: Won order / agreement and entitlement setup
tasks.basis: Count the agreement once even if it includes a licence and briefing. Negotiation incurred before a lost order belongs in WS05/WS06. A signature/order record is not receipt of cash or completed fulfilment.

tasks.label: Customer-specific reading path through existing research
tasks.basis: The full free research benefit remains intact. Generic summary/preview and existing reading-path assets are reused; do not re-charge WR09/WR16 or repeat the same path because a bundle has several labels. Fresh evidence collection is outside this task.

tasks.label: Scoped client/public-use asset preparation and context check
tasks.basis: Use the existing rights review and original design from WR10/WR12. Charge only the additional permitted adaptation/check; no default third-party chart/identity/quote rights, blanket sublicence or new evidence. Multiple genuinely different agreed packages can require repeated work.

tasks.label: Partner recognition and benefit-register setup
tasks.basis: If research is already commissioned/complete, do not describe it as a new commission. This task excludes the licence/briefing work counted in WS07–WS09/WS12–WS15. No contact access, seats, exclusivity, favourable conclusions or recurring reporting is presumed.

tasks.label: Explicit partner benefit fulfilment administration
tasks.basis: No default monthly report or newly compulsory partner service. Reuse invoice, delivery and briefing records; do not redo the underlying work. Multiple real checks can create legitimate additional hours within the same bundle; do not remove them merely because the bundle is counted once.

tasks.label: Full-research fulfilment delivery run
tasks.basis: A common batch is counted once; no second free-copy charge for the same send. An additional recipient-specific delivery action or separate run is incremental real work, not a second research-production cost. Effort depends on recipient/route complexity; override the hours when material.

tasks.label: Scoped briefing preparation and scheduling
tasks.basis: No new research, unlimited inquiry or promised turnaround. Reuse a prepared briefing and count only the necessary preparation delta for a repeat audience/session. If an unchanged reusable preparation package supports several sessions, assign it once rather than duplicating full preparation. One joint session serving several entitled customers/partners is one session, not one per attendee or bundle.

tasks.label: Live scoped briefing delivery
tasks.basis: Duration/headcount are planning choices, not promised session lengths or staffing. A second necessary presenter is real additional person-time; do not multiply the same full task hours by every role. A repeat session is a real repeat unit even if preparation is reused.

tasks.label: Bounded briefing follow-through
tasks.basis: No general analyst inquiry desk, compliance advice, bespoke consulting, new study or recurring support is assumed. If one shared follow-up is reused for multiple sessions, allocate the common work once; genuinely different follow-up remains incremental.

tasks.label: Service-case triage and routing
tasks.basis: WS18 contains resolution and closing work for this same case; do not include it here. Paid, bundled and free recipients can create cases. No new support entitlement or participant form is created; fresh research/advice is outside the scope.

tasks.label: Invoice, receipt and fulfilment-status administration
tasks.basis: Invoice, cash receipt and delivery remain different statuses. Do not count invoice value and receipt as two revenues. Costs already included in supplier/package/admin fees are reconciled once. No tax/recovery/payment-platform rule is presumed.

tasks.label: Service-case resolution, correction routing and close

tasks.basis: No auto-renewal, subscription, annual update, future council tenure or new edition is assumed. New prospecting/proposal/research work belongs in the relevant task once; do not add a full second sales cycle here by default.

tasks.label: Optional short cycle follow-through note
